description: The 6th Regular Speaker meeting of RCMDM in RY 2026-27 was held immediately after the 3rd BoD meeting on Saturday 26th September 2026 at the Hall in Purandare Hospital hosted by Rtn. Dr. Anuja and Dr. Shekhar Purandare at their hospital at Chowpatty, Marine Drive, Mumbai, 6.30pm onwards. 18 members/spouses and 14 invited guests were in attendance. Eminent speaker, actor and narrator Dr Bhide was the guest speaker who, supported by a co-actor giving enthralling music on harmonium, gave a fabulous narration in sanskrit and hindi and brilliantly acted on the travesty of life of KARNA in Mahabharata. Dr. Anuja introduced the them and VO Dr. Sanjay and Club Secy Bharti gave vote of thanks. Cake cutting was done for those celebrating Birthdays and Anniversaries. This was followed by sumptuous dinner hosted fabulously by the Purandare family. ALL IN ALL A FABULOUS SET OF MEETINGS.
